approval_required_for: Any requested change to checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, expected-output generation method, numeric policy/tolerance, testbench contract, Transformer-block DUT scope, architecture, pipeline semantics, or memory layout; none is authorized by this plan.

Any ambiguity in the exact user-supplied board wrapper, simulation sources, Vivado-export authority, or executable identity. Such ambiguity requires bounded human approval rather than guessed integration facts.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep all listed barriers and retry requests active, treat the rejected Stage7 artifacts only as planning/debug evidence, and block downstream promotion until the SACG ledger can be validated.
executable_actions.rationale: The authoritative scoped SACG truth contains 9 active rejected-artifact barriers and 3 open Stage7 retry requests. Record them as downstream-consumption blockers so the failed Stage7 artifacts remain debug inputs only and cannot be silently reused as validated design inputs.

consumes: passed case_board_interface_discovery identity and exact user-supplied board-wrapper source hashes
current immutable numeric policy and frozen framework defaults when a value was initially absent
executable_actions.on_failure: Classify any absent catalog entry, target-model execution, fixed numeric policy, exact-wrapper source binding, or authorized compile-plan fact as a verification-capability blocker. Do not edit existing goldens, change tolerance/checkpoint/stimulus/contract, substitute a simplified wrapper, run a fallback simulation, or assert DUT weight consumption.
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the missing verification capability before requesting a hardware trace. Materialize a content-addressed board testbench and multilayer loader/harness using the existing immutable verification contract, exact discovered board wrapper/source identity, fixed checkpoint/stimulus, and target-model reference. Catalog the complete checkpoint with scope classification, but require DUT binding and expected block outputs only for all Transformer-block tensors in every target layer; do not add model-tail work.

executable_actions.on_failure: Return only the reported missing tensor, loader-binding, source-hash, or harness-closure delta to repair.01. Do not start VCS, diagnose RTL, reopen lower layers, or alter immutable numeric/reference inputs until this gate passes.
executable_actions.rationale: case_multilayer_pipeline is the first executable failed dependency. Rerun it against the newly content-addressed candidate to prove complete Transformer-block tensor-to-loader-to-DUT binding coverage and hash-verified multilayer harness source closure before attempting AXI/DDR or VCS tools.

consumes: exact user-supplied board wrapper and simulation source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Repair only source-identity, exact-wrapper binding, testbench loading, or command-authority defects and rerun repair.02 and this action if their hashed inputs changed. If the current materials are ambiguous rather than contradictory, stop and request bounded human approval; do not guess wrapper, module, board, executable, or path names.
executable_actions.rationale: After the multilayer pipeline gate passes, validate that the exact discovered board wrapper, generated board_tb.sv, source-identity document, and VCS ordered commands form an authorized compile plan. This addresses the currently reported AXI/DDR interface precondition defects without modifying the kernel.

consumes: exact board wrapper and board_tb.sv source hashes
current immutable numeric policy and stimulus provenance
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not patch RTL from a frontier symptom alone. Send the current hash-bound trace to repair.05 for CCTG localization; independent AXI/prefetch progress must not be reported as output/lifecycle progress, and no lower-layer certificate may be reopened without the required direct contradiction evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: With static semantic and AXI/DDR prerequisites passed, run the exact board-wrapped target replay. Capture direct core lifecycle start, ingress acceptance, egress acceptance, named causal boundaries, AXI progress, output/lifecycle frontier, data order, transfer counts, and executed Transformer-block weight consumption. The target-model expected outputs and numeric policy remain immutable.

consumes: exact board wrapper, testbench, and compile-plan hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: If the trace lacks any required core-start, ingress, egress, named-boundary, source-hash, or lower-certificate binding, request an expanded current board replay rather than a code patch. If no direct named contradiction exists, constrain repair to the board wrapper/runtime/harness causal slice and keep both lower layers closed.
produces: repair/scoped_lower_layer_backtrack_request.json only if a direct named certificate contradiction is proven
executable_actions.rationale: A real replay failure must be localized to the earliest causal boundary before proposing a board integration repair. Compare the current trace against the live lower-layer certificates, requiring direct core-start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and current-certificate evidence for any claimed contradiction. Preserve the certified kernel's elastic variable-latency semantics: boundary order and cross-token overlap are required, not equal same-cycle stage completion.

executable_actions.on_failure: For a semantic artifact or weight-consumption failure, return to repair.01 with the exact missing evidence. For a real protocol, order, liveness, or value failure, return to repair.05 with the current trace. Do not promote, weaken tolerance, edit target-model outputs, or reopen a lower layer absent a direct certificate contradiction.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after a passing exact-wrapper functional replay, execute the remaining dependency-ordered board checks and assemble semantic evidence. This verifies multilayer function, liveness, AXI protocol, DDR image roundtrip, immutable numeric comparison, data order, and target-model/real-weight evidence without treating any smoke result as promotion evidence.

consumes: passing case_multilayer_pipeline, case_axi_ddr_interface, functional_sim, case_multilayer_functional, case_pipeline_deadlock_check, case_axi_protocol_check, case_ddr_image_roundtrip, and case_board_semantic_evidence reports
all current board source, checkpoint, stimulus, target-reference, numeric-policy, harness, and trace hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep every retry request and contamination barrier active and preserve non-promotion status. A partial pass, missing hash, dependency-skipped tool, or unverifiable consumption trace is not eligible to supersede prior rejected artifacts.
executable_actions.rationale: The active barriers and open retries are downstream-consumption blockers until a complete, content-addressed board-scope candidate passes every required Stage7 gate. Reconcile by linking, not overwriting, retry_request.0136 through retry_request.0138 and contamination_barrier.0329 through contamination_barrier.0337 to the new candidate and its exact evidence hashes.

observations: real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline is the authoritative earliest executed failure. Its reported blockers are incomplete DUT binding for every required Transformer-block weight in every target layer and missing hash-verified multilayer harness sources.

board_tb.sv is absent, so functional_sim is a failed precondition/composite gate. case_vcs_functional_sim, its evidence analyzer, AXI/deadlock diagnostics, and all downstream board checks are not_run; no board-wrapped RTL value, ordering, protocol, deadlock, or output-frontier failure has been executed.

The pending analyzer report describing completed inputs with zero accepted output beats is not executable current-scope evidence: its persisted diagnosis has no source-bound applicability binding and its tool status is not_run. It must not be used to select an RTL root cause.

The hash-bound lower-layer certificates remain live: operator leaves passed semantic comparison, and the connected kernel passed required boundary order and cross-token overlap under elastic variable-latency token-pipeline semantics. No current board trace directly contradicts either certificate, so neither lower layer is reopened.

The current scope has 9 active contamination barriers, contamination_barrier.0329 through contamination_barrier.0337, and 3 open Stage7 retry requests, retry_request.0136 through retry_request.0138. These block downstream consumption and promotion; omitted cross-layer blockers are not executable blockers for this repair scope.

The conditional design-team router made no specialist split. Its no-split result is consistent with treating this as a bounded checker/harness capability repair rather than a hardware-correctness claim.

Any new expected outputs must be produced by independent target-model execution on the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus. A deterministic generator may supply inputs only; it cannot supply expected outputs. The full checkpoint catalog must be complete, while DUT binding and golden scope must include Transformer blocks only.
proposed_actions: Record the active Stage7 trust barriers and retry requests as non-promotion constraints before generating replacement evidence.

Build only the missing board-scoped semantic harness, target-model reference, full checkpoint catalog, Transformer-block binding manifest, and exact-wrapper-bound board_tb.sv under the existing immutable Stage6 contract.
Rerun case_multilayer_pipeline first. If it remains failing, repair only the reported catalog/binding/harness closure and do not launch hardware diagnostics.
After the pipeline gate passes, validate exact board source identity and the authorized VCS compile plan with case_axi_ddr_interface.

Run the first current board-layer targeted replay with boundary monitors, then localize the earliest observed boundary from real VCS evidence. Reopen lower layers only if this trace directly contradicts a named live certificate invariant.

Only after functional replay passes, execute the remaining multilayer, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, and semantic-evidence gates in dependency order, then reconcile the Stage7 retry/barrier records against a content-addressed passing candidate.
risks: A manifest or files on disk cannot prove DUT consumption. Functional promotion requires an executed, hash-bound per-tensor loader-to-DUT consumption trace covering every required Transformer-block tensor in every target layer.

The generated board testbench and VCS compile plan can accidentally substitute a simplified wrapper or lose exact Vivado-export/source identity. The repair must bind the currently discovered user-supplied wrapper and source hashes, not infer names or paths.

Changing atol, rtol, max_mismatch_fraction, checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, expected outputs, or testbench contract would invalidate the repair. Numeric values must come from the current immutable policy or authorized frozen framework defaults only, never DUT output.

Once a real board replay runs, independent AXI/prefetch activity is not output or lifecycle-frontier progress. Any frontier stall needs direct core-start, ingress, egress, and named causal-boundary evidence before identifying a root cause or reopening the connected kernel.

No backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board-runtime promotion is allowed while the current Stage7 retry requests and contamination barriers remain unreconciled by a complete content-addressed passing board candidate.

constraints: immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper source hashes
Transformer blocks only: embeddings/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling are outside DUT weight coverage and golden boundaries
rejected Stage7 artifacts are planning/debug evidence only until content-addressed retry promotion
edges: immutable checkpoint tensor catalog -> Transformer-block scoped loader binding -> exact board harness -> executed DUT weight-consumption trace
target-model reference for fixed checkpoint and stimulus -> immutable numeric comparison -> board functional replay
case_multilayer_pipeline pass -> case_axi_ddr_interface pass -> VCS boundary trace and current-layer localization
current board trace with direct lower-certificate contradiction -> narrowly scoped lower-layer backtrack; otherwise lower certificates remain reused
content-addressed passing board candidate -> retry/barrier reconciliation eligibility

output.summary: Do not promote the board AXI/DDR closure. The earliest executable current-scope failure is the verification-capability gate case_multilayer_pipeline: complete per-target-layer Transformer-block tensor-to-loader-to-DUT binding and hash-verified multilayer harness sources are absent, and board_tb.sv is missing. The aggregate functional_sim failure is dependency-blocked, not executed RTL/VCS evidence. Repair the immutable-contract-compliant board harness and binding evidence first, then rerun the failed static gates, execute an exact-wrapper board trace, and localize only any newly observed real-tool failure. Certified operator-leaf and connected-kernel evidence remains reusable; no current trace contradicts a named lower-layer invariant.
